text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are presenting with hematuria and right flank pain. To help narrow down the cause, can you describe exactly where the pain is located and if it radiates to your groin? Also, how much blood is in your urine?

speaker: Patient
text: 42-year-old Caucasian male. The patient reports experiencing visible blood in his urine accompanied by discomfort in his right flank. He denies any recent trauma to the area. He mentions a series of urinary tract infections over the past few years but has not been on renal dialysis.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Renal Cell Carcinoma.
